author: Wil Day
title: Tracy Lawrence coming to Wichita in May - NewsBreak
text:
By Wil Day ,
5 hours ago
WICHITA, Kan. (KSNW) — Country music icon Tracy Lawrence is coming to Wichita.
He will be bringing his 2026 No Alibis tour to Century II in May.
“This year felt like the right time to lean back into headlining more shows and really celebrate these songs with the folks who’ve been there from the beginning and love real country music,” Lawrence said in a news release. “The No Alibis Tour is about showing up and sharing a night that reminds us why we fell in love with country music in the first place. I can’t wait to sing all the hits together!”
Grappler used to catch theft suspect in Wichita, police say Known for No. 1 hits like “Time Marches On” and “Find Out Who Your Friends Are,” Lawrence has released 14 albums over the past three decades, starting with 1991’s Sticks and Stones. He has one Country Music Association Award and two Academy of Country Music Awards.
The concert is scheduled for May 14 at 7:30 p.m. Tickets go on sale at 10 a.m. Friday. They’re available through Select-A-Seat by phone at 855-755-SEAT (7328), online at selectaseat.com , or in person at the Century II Box Office and the Select-A-Seat Box Office at Intrust Bank Arena.
